data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure closely and in order (venue search with suggestion, optional date, event selection, filter, sort, times, Update Search) and names all the key parameters, but it leaves out the final Book Now click and hardcodes an accessibility filter as a required step when the amenity filter should be an optional parameter.
